column1: # Grammar patterns of the NIKL curriculum list (data/curriculum_grammar.tsv) that krdict has no row for;
# merged into the core pack as source 'hanppuri' entries plus grammar rows, so every curriculum pattern resolves.
# A row is skipped (retired) once krdict has a grammar row with the same pattern.
# Tab-separated; the first column says which kind of row it is. Rows of one pattern are grouped:
# the P row, then its E rows (examples, in display order).
#   P  pattern  category  nikl_level  ko_def  ko_def_source  en_summary  [forms]
#   E  pattern  ko  ko_source  en
# pattern       headword as it is shown (leading hyphen for endings); matches a form of the curriculum list.
# category      connective ending | final ending | expression | particle.
# nikl_level    1-6, the curriculum grade (the entry's krdict-style level is (n+1)/2).
# ko_def        Korean definition.
# ko_def_source stdict:<ext_id> | opendict:<ext_id> (text copied verbatim from that dictionary entry) | ai.
# en_summary    English summary. Always AI-written (English is ours; the entry carries def_ai).
# forms         further lookup spellings, comma-separated (hyphens/spaces do not matter), may be empty.
# ko            example sentence.
# ko_source     stdict | opendict (copied verbatim from that dictionary) | ai (written for this file).
# en            English translation. Always AI-written (en_ai).
# Every AI-written field is listed in qa/curriculum/grammar_extra_review.md for an independent check;
# nothing here counts as reviewed until that file says so.
P
column5: (예스러운 표현으로) ‘하다가 보면’의 뜻을 나타내는 연결 어미.
column7: A somewhat literary connective ending: "if you keep doing ..., (in time) ...". Attaches to a verb stem, to 있다/없다/계시다, or after -으시-.

column1: E
column5: If you keep living diligently, there will be good days too.

column1: E
column3: 앞을 향해 계속 가노라면 오른쪽에 붉은 기와집이 나타날 것이다.
column5: If you keep going straight ahead, a red-tiled house will appear on your right.

column1: P
column5: 앞에 오는 행위나 상태가 어떠한가에 따라 뒤에 오는 결과나 판단이 달라짐을 나타내는 표현.
column7: An expression meaning "depending on how (one) does something": the result after it changes with the way the verb before -기 is done. Often with 달라지다/다르다.

column1: E
column3: 이 옷은 입기에 따라 느낌이 많이 달라진다.
column5: How this outfit feels changes a lot depending on how you wear it.

column5: Studying can be as enjoyable as you like, depending on how you set your mind.

column3: 같은 재료도 요리하기에 따라 전혀 다른 맛이 난다.

column5: 어떤 일을 하기 전에 먼저 다른 일을 함을 나타내는 표현.
column7: An expression meaning "before doing ...": what follows is done first, ahead of the action named before -기에. The 서 may be added (-기에 앞서서).

column5: Before we begin the meeting, I will hand out the materials.
